news.analysis: Nix threw touchdowns to Jaylen Waddle and Nate Adkins without turning the ball over. The Broncos quarterback didn't offer much on the ground, but he has now thrown four touchdowns and zero interceptions over his last two games. Nix gets the Panthers in Week 9.
news.contents: Bo Nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns, while rushing three times for four yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.

He's had games as the team's lead back and just as many as a non-factor in the offense. However, Mitchell could get a bye-week bump after Mike McDaniel got an extra week to scheme touches for him. He is a role-dependent player who can be an offensive weapon when schemed up correctly. Entering Week 8, Mitchell is RotoBaller's PPR RB47 in a tough matchup against the Los Angeles Rams. news.analysis: Downs was the only Colts player to get into the end zone Sunday, scoring his first touchdown of the season on a six-yard pass from Daniel Jones late in the third quarter. Overall, Downs has mostly been a disappointment for fantasy managers this season. He has caught four or fewer passes in each of the last five games without reaching 50 yards in any of them.

Schefter reports that the Colts have asked for a third-round pick for the fourth-year receiver but could settle for a fourth-rounder before the deadline. news.analysis: Mitchell turned in a career performance just one week after being blanked on the stat sheet. The 24-year-old found the end zone on a 12-yard reception in the second quarter and logged a team long 47-yard reception in the fourth quarter. Mitchell and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

It didn't make much of a difference, however, as the second-year TE struggled in what was a terrible performance from the Colts on the whole. Warren's production should improve from here, but the Colts' offense is a difficult one to trust.

news.analysis: Ward fumbled twice, losing one, but he surprisingly kept his team in it against a tough Bengals offense. The second-year quarterback completed his touchdown passes to Chimere Dike and Wan'Dale Robinson in the contest. Ward has now thrown for 1,483 yards, six touchdowns, and five interceptions through eight games. He will be on a bye in Week 9.
news.contents: Cam Ward completed 26 of his 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns while adding 41 rushing yards on seven rushes in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.title: Cam Ward throws two TDs in Week 8 loss

news.analysis: Henderson will sit out while continuing to battle an illness that kept the running back from practicing throughout the week for head coach Mike Vrabel. Rhamondre Stevenson will receive as many touches as he can handle out of the backfield against the Dolphins Sunday.

news.contents: New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's contest against the Miami Dolphins. The second-year running back out of Ohio State couldn't practice Thursday or Friday and didn't make enough progress to be cleared to play. This will mark Henderson's second missed game this season, as he couldn't suit up in Week 1 due to an ankle injury. news.analysis: With trade rumors swirling around him, Thomas was certainly still part of the plan for the Jaguars on Sunday. He hauled in his second touchdown of the campaign, scoring from 12 yards out on the team's opening drive. Thomas only saw two targets on the day, but no Jaguars player received more than three. He's still not a player to throw right back into fantasy lineups, but Thomas should be kept on the radar.
news.contents: Brian Thomas Jr. caught 1-of-2 targets for a 12-yard touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 rout of the Colts.
news.title: Brian Thomas Jr. finds the end zone in Week 8 win

news.contents: The Jacksonville Jaguars "haven't shown much inclination" to trade wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr., according to Mike Florio of Pro Football Talk. The Chiefs, Steelers, and Commanders have reportedly all shown interest in trading for Thomas, and Florio notes that the former first-round pick may also be looking for a fresh start. Over the last two weeks, Mumpfield posted a 45% snap share with five targets, three catches, and 30 receiving yards. news.analysis: Helm led the Titans in targets and receiving yards with Carnell Tate sidelined by a shoulder injury. The veteran tight end has drawn 13 targets over his past two games as he is starting to carve out a larger role in the Tennessee passing game. He will be on bye in Week 9.

news.contents: Tennessee Titans tight end Gunnar Helm hauled in five of nine targets for 76 yards in the team's 43-36 overtime loss to the hosting Cincinnati Bengals. Helm led the team in receiving yards on Sunday and set career highs with his yardage and target total. In fact, the former Texas Longhorn fell just three yards shy of matching his receiving total for the season in this game alone. It was a nice effort on a day that the team was short a receiving option in wideout Carnell Tate (shoulder). ...
